# usfootballR

`usfootballR` is an R package for working with American soccer data. The
package has functions to access **live play-by-play and box score** data
from ESPN with shot locations when available.

A scraping and aggregating interface for ESPN’s MLS and NWSL statistics.
It provides users with the capability to access the API’s game
play-by-plays, box scores, standings and results to analyze the data for
themselves.

## Installation

You can install the released version of
[**`usfootballR`**](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/usfootballR) from
[GitHub](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/usfootballR) with:

``` r

# You can install using the pacman package using the following code:
if (!requireNamespace('pacman', quietly = TRUE)){
  install.packages('pacman')
}
pacman::p_load_current_gh("sportsdataverse/usfootballR", dependencies = TRUE, update = TRUE)
```

## Documentation

For more information on the package and function reference, please see
the [**`usfootballR`** documentation
website](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org).

# Package index

## usfootballR Data

### MLS Data Functions

Functions exported by usfootballR to access the usfootballR-data
repository’s MLS Data

- [`load_mls_pbp()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/load_mls_pbp.md)
  :

  **Load usfootballR MLS play-by-play**

- [`load_mls_team_box()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/load_mls_team_box.md)
  :

  **Load usfootballR MLS team box scores**

- [`load_mls_player_box()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/load_mls_player_box.md)
  :

  **Load usfootballR MLS player box scores**

- [`load_mls_schedule()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/load_mls_schedule.md)
  :

  **Load usfootballR MLS schedules**

- [`update_mls_db()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/update_mls_db.md)
  :

  **Update or create a usfootballR play-by-play database**

### NWSL Data Functions

Functions exported by usfootballR to access the usfootballR-data
repository’s NWSL Data

- [`load_nwsl_pbp()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/load_nwsl_pbp.md)
  :

  **Load usfootballR NWSL play-by-play**

- [`load_nwsl_team_box()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/load_nwsl_team_box.md)
  :

  **Load usfootballR NWSL team box scores**

- [`load_nwsl_player_box()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/load_nwsl_player_box.md)
  :

  **Load usfootballR NWSL player box scores**

- [`load_nwsl_schedule()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/load_nwsl_schedule.md)
  :

  **Load usfootballR NWSL schedules**

- [`update_nwsl_db()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/update_nwsl_db.md)
  :

  **Update or create a usfootballR play-by-play database**

## ESPN Data

### MLS Data Functions

Functions exported by usfootballR to access ESPN’s MLS Data

- [`espn_mls_game_all()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_mls_game_all.md)
  : Get ESPN's MLS game data (play-by-play, team)
- [`espn_mls_pbp()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_mls_pbp.md)
  : Get ESPN's MLS play by play data
- [`espn_mls_scoreboard()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_mls_scoreboard.md)
  : Get MLS schedule for a specific year/date from ESPN's API
- [`espn_mls_standings()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_mls_standings.md)
  : Get ESPN MLS Standings
- [`espn_mls_team_box()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_mls_team_box.md)
  : Get ESPN's MLS team box data
- [`espn_mls_teams()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_mls_teams.md)
  : Get ESPN's MLS team names and ids

### NWSL Data Functions

Functions exported by usfootballR to access ESPN’s NWSL Data

- [`espn_nwsl_game_all()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_nwsl_game_all.md)
  : Get ESPN's NWSL game data (play-by-play, team)
- [`espn_nwsl_pbp()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_nwsl_pbp.md)
  : Get ESPN's NWSL play by play data
- [`espn_nwsl_scoreboard()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_nwsl_scoreboard.md)
  : Get NWSL schedule for a specific year/date from ESPN's API
- [`espn_nwsl_standings()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_nwsl_standings.md)
  : Get ESPN NWSL Standings
- [`espn_nwsl_team_box()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_nwsl_team_box.md)
  : Get ESPN's NWSL team box data
- [`espn_nwsl_teams()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/espn_nwsl_teams.md)
  : Get ESPN's NWSL team names and ids

## Helpers

### Helper Functions

Functions used internally by usfootballR which assist in transforming or
loading data

- [`csv_from_url()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/csv_from_url.md)
  :

  **Load .csv / .csv.gz file from a remote connection**

- [`rds_from_url()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/rds_from_url.md)
  :

  **Load .rds file from a remote connection**

- [`progressively()`](https://usfootballR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/progressively.md)
  : Progressively
